title: 有馬記念の後に・うそみたい

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan finishes the race so drained she can't even speak. And yet, victory remained out of reach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her rivals, on the other hand, have the energy to chat away about things she can't understand. It's like they live in a different world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She feels that she's not as smart or capable as her friends, and that all my efforts amounted to no good because of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Convinced that she's a dummy—a dummy so dumb she didn't even realize how dumb she was—Jordan lets out a bitter laugh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She doesn't want to embarrass herself anymore. I have the Osaka Hai in mind for her next goal, but she runs from training.
